enabled.description: Extract grounded claims and events from source revisions.

maxSourcesPerRun.description: Maximum source revisions analyzed per run (runs every ten minutes).

maxContentChars.description: Maximum verbatim characters supplied per source window; later cron runs continue the revision.

deterministicMode.description: Deterministic extraction tier (gazetteer links, typed mentions, dated claims, structural involvement): off; shadow records its verdict beside the model's in graph_shadow_decisions; active merges it into each extraction and gives the model the linked entities.

predicateSchema.description: Closed relation schema for model claims: active maps predicates onto it and asks the model to use it (the original wording stays in qualifiers.rawPredicate); shadow records the mapping in qualifiers.canonicalPredicate only; off keeps free-form predicates.

skipLlmWhenCovered.description: In active deterministic mode, skip the model for windows whose every name is linked or typed; the digest then gets an extractive summary.

templateMode.description: Email template tier: bulk mail is clustered by sender and subject skeleton, a wrapper is induced per template, and the model labels each template's slots once. off; shadow records the template digest beside the model's in graph_shadow_decisions (kind template) and still calls the model; active digests matching mail from its template without a model call (boilerplate templates get an empty extraction and the subject as summary).

templateMinMembers.description: Messages a sender/subject cluster needs before a template is induced from it.

templateMinAlignment.description: Minimum wrapper alignment score (matched constant text over constant plus unexplained text) for a message to count as following a template; below it the template has drifted and the model reads the message.

maxTemplateLabelsPerRun.description: Templates labelled by the model per run (one call each, outside transactions).

maxTemplateInductionsPerRun.description: Template clusters (re)induced per run; the rest wait for the next run.
